title: Holy Grail
body:
Holy Grail-quest item.

To start the quest enter the furnace behind the Bob Fridman in The Oak Depot store. In the furnace there's an enter to King Oakler's Basement.

The quest includes 9 stages:

  1. The Grail Beckons
  2. Sir Birdivere The Wise
  3. Sir Wallahad the Pure
  4. Sir Vector
  5. Goblin Guard's Riddles
  6. Sir Goblin the Not-Quite-So Brave
  7. Sir Dancealot the Brave
  8. Sir Doors
  9. The Forgotten Grail

The Grail Beckons:

  • Talk to King Oakler.

Sir Birdivere The Wise:

  • Go to the beach
  • Search the beach for Sir Birdivere The Wise.

Sir Wallahad the Pure:

  • Go to the Azure Fields.
  • Search the island for Sir Wallahad the Pure.

Sir Vector:

  • Go to the Acidlands
  • Find the Ancient Shrine.
  • Climb the Spire.
  • Find Sir Vector.

...

Holy Grail can be unboxed. If you unbox it, model will change on mannequin knight.
